question: Should the fire-pits aligned with those directions be made circular or angular in shape?
premises: The fire-pits are aligned with those directions.
The fire-pits may be made circular in shape.
Alternatively the fire-pits may be made angular in shape.
inference: One should arrange the directional fire-pits as either circular or angular.
uncertainties: The precise referent of astrāṇi in this ritual context is not fully explicit.
plain_english: One should arrange the fire-pits of those directions so that they are either circular or angular.
